svg.title: Gradient descent, and the learning rate that blew up
svg.desc: On the left a ball rolls down a hand-drawn loss bowl in five numbered steps that get shorter as the slope flattens, at a learning rate of 0.05. On the right the same bowl at a learning rate of 0.9 sends the ball bouncing further up the walls each step; the panel is crossed out in red and annotated loss 4.1 to 9.8 to 61 to NaN.
